main_text.head: Quæstio XIV.
An in Theatralibus spectaculis exercenda juventus?
main_text.p: ORbis terræ, Theatrum est: in hoc personam agimus omnes: Et adoratas regum majestates, pariter cum ludicro Tyranno, sæpè circumscripsit hora una. Quid ni igitur, ô juvenes, optabile sit in Scenam quandoque prodire? id est gratâ vicissitudine, à magno illo Theatro, in parvum quoddam secedere: ac ibidem exutâ plebis quam inviti geritis, personâ, parferè cum Mundi Monarchis, momento debacchari. Adde, Proceres & Satrapas & circumfusum incurvo poplite Satellitium, quæ in vasto illo Proscenio perduellis est hîc esse tutam turbam: Conspiren- quam-

page.notes: The initial O is a woodcut initial, joined to "Orbis". Right margin fragments are show-through and partly legible marginal notes, not transcribed. The word "Conspirent" is broken at the line end ("Confpiren-" then "quam-" as the catchword-like continuation); the last line "quam-" is a catchword and the text is given as printed. Where the printed line reads "Confpiren-", the printed form is "Conspirent" continued in the next line, which is illegible in the scan.
